newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rhone reorganises health, agro units.
newsitem.headline: Rhone reorganises health, agro units.

text.p: Chemicals group Rhone-Poulenc said on Monday that it was reorganising its animal and plant health activities to increase synergies between the two sectors and enhance the visibility of their results.

It said in a statement that, as of January 1, the health and agro sectors would be replaced by a pharmaceuticals unit comprising Rhone-Poulenc Rorer and Pasteur Merieux Connaught and an animal and plant health unit comprising crop protection, veterinary pharmaceuticals and poultry genetics and animal nutrition activities.
"This new organisation will lead to an improved visibility of its financial results...and better use of the synergies which exist between the animal and plant health activities," Rhone said.
Alain Godard, president of the current agro sector, has been appointed supervisor of the animal and plant health unit and will join the group's executive committee.
Michel Maupu, who heads the European business of the agro sector, will be president of the crop protection business.
Igor Landau will supervise the pharmaceuticals sector.
